scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:setup && docker compose --env-file .local/docker.env up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 150
scripts.monitoring:up: npm run docker:setup && docker compose --env-file .local/docker.env --profile monitoring up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 150
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tirek/contracts && npm run build -w @tirek/api && npm run build -w @tirek/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tirek/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @tirek/api && npm run typecheck -w @tirek/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @tirek/contracts && npm run test -w @tirek/api && npm run test:i18n
